label: Bible Study
prompt: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet _____, Christ died for us.
verse: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
note: Not after we cleaned up — 'while we were yet sinners.'

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: What time I am afraid, I will _____ in thee.
verse: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
note: David doesn't pretend he's never afraid — he just has a plan for 'what time' he is.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the LORD said unto him, What is that in thine hand? And he said, A _____.
verse: And the LORD said unto him, What is that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.
note: God's question to Moses: what's already in your hand? A shepherd's rod, about to have a career.

label: Deep Water
prompt: The _____ is mine, and the gold is mine, saith the LORD of hosts.
verse: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, saith the LORD of hosts.
note: God's word to temple-builders worried about funding: the treasury was never the problem.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For we have not followed cunningly devised _____, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
verse: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
note: Not 'cunningly devised fables' — Peter's defense rests on eyewitnesses, not storytellers.
